headline: Former Football Kenya Federation Official Challenges Removal By Fifa
seoTitle: Ex-FKF Official Challenges Ouster With Fifa
metaDescription: Former Football Kenya Federation official MacDonald Mariga has appealed to Fifa following his controversial ouster during a recent meeting in Meru.
aiSummaryBullets: MacDonald Mariga has submitted documentation to Fifa to contest his removal from the Football Kenya Federation vice presidency.
The ouster occurred during a tumultuous special general meeting in Meru that involved police intervention and the removal of several NEC members.
A formal court petition has been filed by an external party seeking to suspend the recent changes and restore the federation's previous leadership status.
aiContextParagraph: The leadership dispute within the Football Kenya Federation (FKF) escalated following a special general meeting held in Meru on November 7, 2026. During the proceedings, which were marked by significant disorder and the deployment of police, vice president MacDonald Mariga and six National Executive Committee members were removed from their positions. Mr. Mariga has since publicly disputed the legality of the assembly's actions, characterizing the transition as a betrayal by president Hussein Mohamed. He has subsequently engaged global football governing body Fifa to review the details of the internal conflict. Meanwhile, the legal system has been drawn into the matter, as a petitioner has requested the courts to issue conservatory orders aimed at nullifying the decisions made in Meru and reverting the federation's governance to its state prior to the November meeting. The situation highlights recurring administrative instability within the national football organization.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained significant attention across three independent news outlets due to the high-profile nature of the football federation and the public reports of physical chaos during the leadership meeting.
